verses.geez: ወልድ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ያስተፌሥሕ፡ አባሁ፡ ወወልድ፡ ዓብድ፡ ያኃዝና፡ ለእሙ።
verses.translation: A wise son makes his father glad: but a foolish son is a grief to his mother.

translations.lxx: A wise son makes his father glad: but a foolish son is a grief to his mother.
translations.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
translations.ron: Pildele lui Solomon. Fiul înţelept înveseleşte pe tatăl său, iar cel nebun este supărarea maicii lui.
translations.grk: Υἱὸς σοφὸς εὐφραίνει πατέρα, υἱὸς δὲ ἄφρων λύπη τῇ μητρί.

verses.geez: ኢይበቊዕ፡ መዛግብት፡ ለኃጥአን፡ ጽድቅሰ፡ ታድኅን፡ እሞት።
verses.translation: Treasures shall not profit the lawless: but righteousness shall deliver from death.

translations.lxx: Treasures shall not profit the lawless: but righteousness shall deliver from death.
translations.kjv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
translations.ron: Nu sunt de nici un folos comorile dobândite prin fărădelege; numai dreptatea scapă de la moarte.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ὠφελήσουσι θησαυροὶ ἀνόμους, δικαιοσύνη δὲ ῥύσεται ἐκ θανάτου.

verses.geez: ኢያስተፄንስ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ነፍሰ፡ ጻድቅተ፡ ወሕይወተ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ያአትት፡ እምድር።
verses.translation: The Lord will not famish a righteous soul: but he will overthrow the life of the ungodly.

translations.lxx: The Lord will not famish a righteous soul: but he will overthrow the life of the ungodly.
translations.kjv: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
translations.ron: Domnul nu lasă să piară de foame sufletul celui drept; însă el respinge lăcomia celor fără de lege.
translations.grk: Οὐ λιμοκτονήσει Κύριος ψυχὴν δικαίαν, ζωὴν δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀνατρέψει.

verses.geez: እድ፡ ሀካይ፡ ብእሴ፡ ያቴሕት፡ ወእደ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ብእሴ፡ ያብዕል።
verses.translation: Poverty brings a man low: but the hands of the vigorous make rich.

translations.lxx: A son who is instructed shall be wise, and shall use the fool for a servant.
translations.kjv: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
translations.ron: Mâna leneşilor pricinuieşte sărăcie, iar mâna celor înţelepţi adună avuţii.
translations.grk: Πενία ἄνδρα ταπεινοῖ, χεῖρες δὲ ἀνδρείων πλουτίζουσιν· υἱὸς πεπαιδευμένος σοφὸς ἔσται, τῷ δὲ ἄφρονι διακόνῳ χρήσεται.

verses.geez: ወልድ፡ ምሁር፡ ጠቢበ፡ ይከውን፡ ወዓብድሰ፡ ላእከ፡ ይሬሲ፡ ርእሶ፡ ድኅነ፡ እመርቄ፡ ወልድ፡ ጠቢብ።
verses.translation: A wise son is saved from heat: but a lawless son is blighted of the winds in harvest.

translations.lxx: A wise son is saved from heat: but a lawless son is blighted of the winds in harvest.
translations.kjv: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
translations.ron: Cel ce adună în timpul verii este un om prevăzător, iar cel care doarme în vremea secerişului este de ocară.
translations.grk: Διεσώθη ἀπὸ καύματος υἱὸς νοήμων, ἀνεμόφθορος δὲ γίνεται ἐν ἀμητῷ υἱὸς παράνομος.

verses.geez: ወልድ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይትጌበር፡ በማእረር፡ ወወልድሰ፡ ዓብድ፡ ይነውም፡ በማእረር፡ ነሣኤ፡ ነፍስ፡ ይከውን፡ በውስተ፡ ዓውድ፡ ወልድ፡ ኃጥእ።
verses.translation: The blessing of the Lord is upon the head of the just: but untimely grief shall cover the mouth of the ungodly.

translations.lxx: The blessing of the Lord is upon the head of the just: but untimely grief shall cover the mouth of the ungodly.
translations.kjv: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
translations.ron: Binecuvântarea Domnului vine pe capul celui drept, iar ocara acoperă faţa celor fără de lege.
translations.grk: Εὐλογία Κυρίου ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν δικαίου, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν καλύψει πένθος ἄωρον.

verses.geez: በረከተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሰ፡ ጻድቃን፡ አፈረሲዓንሰ፡ ይፌጽም፡ ላህ፡ ግብተ።
verses.translation: The memory of the just is praised; but the name of the ungodly man is extinguished.

translations.lxx: The memory of the just is praised; but the name of the ungodly man is extinguished.
translations.kjv: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
translations.ron: Pomenirea celui drept este spre binecuvântare, iar numele celor nelegiuiţi va fi blestemat.
translations.grk: Μνήμη δικαίων μετʼ ἐγκωμίων, ὄνομα δὲ ἀσεβοῦς σβέννυται.

verses.geez: ዝክረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ምስለ፡ ውዳሴ፡ ወስመ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ይጠፍእ።
verses.translation: A wise man in heart will receive commandments; but he that is unguarded in his lips shall be overthrown in his perverseness.

translations.lxx: A wise man in heart will receive commandments; but he that is unguarded in his lips shall be overthrown in his perverseness.
translations.kjv: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
translations.ron: Cel cu inimă înţeleaptă primeşte sfaturile, iar cel nebun grăieşte vorbe spre pieirea lui.
translations.grk: Σοφὸς καρδίᾳ δέξεται ἐντολὰς, ὁ δὲ ἄστεγος χείλες σκολιάζων ὑποσκελισθήσεται.

verses.geez: ልብ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይትዌከፍ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ወዘኢይትዔገሥ፡ በከናፍሪሁ፡ በማዕቅፍ፡ ይወድቅ።
verses.translation: He that walks simply, walks confidently; but he that perverts his ways shall be known.

translations.lxx: He that walks simply, walks confidently; but he that perverts his ways shall be known.
translations.kjv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
translations.ron: Cel ce umblă întru neprihănire umblă pe cale sigură, iar cel ce umblă pe căi lăturalnice va fi dat de gol.
translations.grk: Ὃς πορεύεται ἁπλῶς, πορεύεται πεποιθώς· ὁ δὲ διαστρέφων τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ, γνωσθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወዘየሐውር፡ በየዋሃት፡ የሐውር፡ እሙነ፡ ወዘይትሀወክ፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ ይትከሠት።
verses.translation: He that winks with his eyes deceitfully, procures griefs for men; but he that reproves boldly is a peacemaker.

translations.lxx: He that winks with his eyes deceitfully, procures griefs for men; but he that reproves boldly is a peacemaker.
translations.kjv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
translations.ron: Cel ce clipeşte din ochi va fi pricină de supărare; iar cel care ceartă cu inimă bună aşază pacea.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἐννεύων ὀφθαλμοῖς μετὰ δόλου, συνάγει ἀνδράσι λύπας· ὁ δὲ ἐλέγχων μετὰ παῤῥησίας, εἰρηνοποιεῖ.

verses.geez: ዘይትቃጸብ፡ በአዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእከይ፡ ያስተጋብእ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ኃዘነ፡ ወዘሰ፡ ይዘልፍ፡ ገሃደ፡ ሰላመ፡ ይገብር።
verses.translation: There is a fountain of life in the hand of a righteous man; but destruction shall cover the mouth of the ungodly.

translations.lxx: There is a fountain of life in the hand of a righteous man; but destruction shall cover the mouth of the ungodly.
translations.kjv: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
translations.ron: Izvor de viaţă este gura celui drept, dar gura celor fără de lege, izvor de nedreptate.
translations.grk: Πηγὴ ζωῆς ἐν χειρὶ δικαίου, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβοῦς καλύψει ἀπώλεια.

verses.geez: ነቅዐ፡ ሕይወት፡ ውስተ፡ አፈ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወለአፈ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ይከድኖ፡ ኃጒል።
verses.translation: Hatred stirs up strife; but affection covers all that do not love strife.

translations.lxx: Hatred stirs up strife; but affection covers all that do not love strife.
translations.kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
translations.ron: Ura aduce ceartă, iar dragostea acopere toate cusururile.
translations.grk: Μῖσος ἐγείρει νεῖκος, πάντας δὲ τοὺς μὴ φιλονεικοῦντας καλύπτει φιλία.

verses.geez: ጽልአ፡ ያነሥእ፡ መዓት፡ ወለኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይትገአዙ፡ ይከድኖሙ፡ ፍቅር።
verses.translation: He that brings forth wisdom from his lips smites the fool with a rod.

translations.lxx: He that brings forth wisdom from his lips smites the fool with a rod.
translations.kjv: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
translations.ron: Pe buzele omului priceput se află înţelepciunea; toiagul este pentru spatele celui lipsit de chibzuinţă.
translations.grk: Ὃ ἐκ χειλέων προφέρει σοφίαν, ῥάβδῳ τύπτει ἄνδρα ἀκάρδιον.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ እምከናፍሪሁ፡ ያወጽእ፡ ጥበበ፡ በበትር፡ ይዘብጥ፡ (ይዘበጥ)፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ልብ።
verses.translation: The wise will hide discretion; but the mouth of the hasty draws near to ruin.

translations.lxx: The wise will hide discretion; but the mouth of the hasty draws near to ruin.
translations.kjv: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
translations.ron: Cei înţelepţi ascund ştiinţa, iar gura celui fără de socotinţă este o nenorocire apropiată.
translations.grk: Σοφοὶ κρύψουσιν αἴσθησιν, στόμα δὲ προπετοῦς ἐγγίζει συντριβῇ.

verses.geez: ጠቢብ፡ የኃብእ፡ አእምሮ፡ ወአፍ፡ ጒጒእ፡ ይቀርብ፡ ለቅጥቃጤ።
verses.translation: The wealth of rich men is a strong city; but poverty is the ruin of the ungodly.

translations.lxx: The wealth of rich men is a strong city; but poverty is the ruin of the ungodly.
translations.kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
translations.ron: Avuţia este pentru cel bogat o cetate întărită; nenorocirea celor sărmani este sărăcia lor.
translations.grk: Κτῆσις πλουσίων πόλις ὀχυρὰ, συντριβὴ δὲ ἀσεβῶν πενία.

verses.geez: ጥሪቶሙ፡ ለአብዕልት፡ ሀገር፡ ጽንዕት፡ ወቅጥቃጤሆሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ንዴተ፡ አእምሮ።
verses.translation: The works of the righteous produce life; but the fruits of the ungodly produce sins.

translations.lxx: The works of the righteous produce life; but the fruits of the ungodly produce sins.
translations.kjv: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
translations.ron: Agonisita celui drept este spre viaţă; roadele celui fără de lege spre păcat;
translations.grk: Ἔργα δικαίων ζωὴν ποιεῖ, καρποὶ δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez: ግብረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ሕይወተ፡ ይገብር፡ ወፍሬ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ኀጢአት።
verses.translation: Instruction keeps the right ways of life; but instruction unchastened goes astray.

translations.lxx: Instruction keeps the right ways of life; but instruction unchastened goes astray.
translations.kjv: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
translations.ron: Cel ce păzeşte învăţătura apucă pe calea vieţii, iar cel ce leapădă certarea rătăceşte.
translations.grk: Ὁδοὺς δικαίας ζωῆς φυλάσσει παιδεία, παιδεία δὲ ἀνεξέλεγκτος πλανᾶται.

verses.geez: ፍናወ፡ ሕይወት፡ የዓቅብ፡ ተግሣፅ፡ በተግሣፅ፡ ዘኢይዘለፍ፡ ይስሕት።
verses.translation: Righteous lips cover enmity; but they that utter railings are most foolish.

translations.lxx: Righteous lips cover enmity; but they that utter railings are most foolish.
translations.kjv: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
translations.ron: Cel care ascunde ura are buze mincinoase; cel ce răspândeşte defăimarea este un nebun.
translations.grk: Καλύπτουσιν ἔχθραν χείλη δίκαια, οἱ δὲ ἐκφέροντες λοιδορίας ἀφρονέστατοί εἰσιν.

verses.geez: ከናፍር፡ ልሙጻት፡ ይከድና፡ ጽልአ፡ ወእለሰ፡ ያወጽኡ፡ ጽእለተ፡ ዓብዳን፡ እሙንቱ።
verses.translation: By a multitude of words thou shalt not escape sin; but if thou refrain thy lips thou wilt be prudent.

translations.lxx: By a multitude of words thou shalt not escape sin; but if thou refrain thy lips thou wilt be prudent.
translations.kjv: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
translations.ron: Mulţimea cuvintelor nu scuteşte de păcătuire, iar cel ce-şi ţine buzele lui este un om înţelept.
translations.grk: Ἐκ πολυλογίας οὐκ ἐκφεύξῃ ἁμαρτίαν, φειδόμενος δὲ χειλέων νοήμων ἔσῃ.

verses.geez: እምብዝኀ፡ ነገር፡ ኢያመስጥ፡ ኃጥእ፡ እምኃጢአት፡ ወዘይምህከሰ፡ በከናፍሪሁ፡ ማእምረ፡ ይከውን።
verses.translation: The tongue of the just is tried silver; but the heart of the ungodly shall fail.

translations.lxx: The tongue of the just is tried silver; but the heart of the ungodly shall fail.
translations.kjv: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
translations.ron: Limba omului drept este argint curat, dar inima celor fără de lege este lucru de puţin preţ.
translations.grk: Ἄργυρος πεπυρωμένος γλῶσσα δικαίου, καρδία δὲ ἀσεβοῦς ἐκλείψει.

verses.geez: ብሩር፡ ርሱን፡ ልሳነ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወልበ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ የሐፅፅ።
verses.translation: The lips of the righteous know sublime truths: but the foolish die in want.

translations.lxx: The lips of the righteous know sublime truths: but the foolish die in want.
translations.kjv: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
translations.ron: Buzele celui drept călăuzesc pe mulţi oameni, iar cei nebuni mor din pricină că nu sunt pricepuţi.
translations.grk: Χείλη δικαίων ἐπίσταται ὑψηλὰ, οἱ δὲ ἄφρονες ἐν ἐνδείᾳ τελευτῶσιν.

verses.geez: ከናፍረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ የአምራ፡ ነዋኀ፡ ወዓብዳንሰ፡ በንዴተ፡ አእምሮ፡ ይመውቱ።
verses.translation: The blessing of the Lord is upon the head of the righteous; it enriches him, and grief of heart shall not be added to it.

translations.lxx: The blessing of the Lord is upon the head of the righteous; it enriches him, and grief of heart shall not be added to it.
translations.kjv: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
translations.ron: Numai binecuvântarea Domnului îmbogăţeşte, iar truda zadarnică nu aduce spor.
translations.grk: Εὐλογία Κυρίου ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν δικαίου, αὕτη πλουτίζει, καὶ οὐ μὴ προστεθῇ αὐτῇ λύπη ἐν καρδίᾳ.

verses.geez: በረከተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእሰ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ይእቲ፡ ታብዕል፡ ወኢታመጽእ፡ ኀዘነ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብ።
verses.translation: A fool does mischief in sport; but wisdom brings forth prudence for a man.

translations.lxx: A fool does mischief in sport; but wisdom brings forth prudence for a man.
translations.kjv: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
translations.ron: Ca o pricină de bucurie este pentru nebun săvârşirea unei fapte ruşinoase; la fel este cu înţelepciunea pentru omul priceput.
translations.grk: Ἐν γέλωτι ἄφρων πράσσει κακὰ, ἡ δὲ σοφία ἀνδρὶ τίκτει φρόνησιν.

verses.geez: ወስተ፡ ሐጒል፡ ይትመየጥ፡ ረሲዕ፡ ፍትወቱ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ ሥምረት፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: The ungodly is engulphed in destruction; but the desire of the righteous is acceptable.

translations.lxx: The ungodly is engulphed in destruction; but the desire of the righteous is acceptable.
translations.kjv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
translations.ron: De ceea ce se teme cel nelegiuit nu scapă, iar cererea celor drepţi (Dumnezeu) o împlineşte.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἀπωλείᾳ ἀσεβὴς περιφέρεται, ἐπιθυμία δὲ δικαίου δεκτή.

verses.geez: በኅልፈተ፡ ዓውሎ፡ ይማስን፡ ረሲዕ፡ ጻድቅሰ፡ ተግኂሦ፡ ለዓለም፡ ይድኅን።
verses.translation: When the storm passes by, the ungodly vanishes away; but the righteous turns aside and escapes for ever.

translations.lxx: When the storm passes by, the ungodly vanishes away; but the righteous turns aside and escapes for ever.
translations.kjv: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
translations.ron: Precum trece furtuna, aşa piere şi cel fără de lege, iar dreptul este ca o temelie neclintită.
translations.grk: Παραπορευομένης καταιγίδος ἀφανίζεται ἀσεβὴς, δίκαιος δὲ ἐκκλίνας σώζεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ቆዕ፡ ከንቱ፡ ለስነን፡ ወጢስ፡ ለዓይን፡ ከማሁ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ለእለ፡ አጥረይዋ።
verses.translation: As a sour grape is hurtful to the teeth, and smoke to the eyes, so iniquity hurts those that practise it.

translations.lxx: As a sour grape is hurtful to the teeth, and smoke to the eyes, so iniquity hurts those that practise it.
translations.kjv: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
translations.ron: Precum este oţetul pentru dinţi şi fumul pentru ochi, aşa este omul leneş pentru cei ce-l pun la treabă.
translations.grk: Ὥσπερ ὄμφαξ ὀδοῦσι βλαβερὸν, καὶ καπνὸς ὄμμασιν, οὕτως παρανομία τοῖς χρωμένοις αὐτῇ.

verses.geez: ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ያነውኅ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ወዓመተ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ይውኅድ።
verses.translation: The fear of the Lord adds length of days: but the years of the ungodly shall be shortened.

translations.lxx: The fear of the Lord adds length of days: but the years of the ungodly shall be shortened.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
translations.ron: Frica de Dumnezeu lungeşte zilele (omului), iar anii celor fără de lege sunt puţini.
translations.grk: Φόβος Κυρίου προστίθησιν ἡμέρας, ἔτη δὲ ἀσεβῶν ὀλιγωθήσεται.

verses.geez: ትጐነዲ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ምስለ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ተስፋሆሙሰ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ትትኀጐል።
verses.translation: Joy rests long with the righteous: but the hope of the ungodly shall perish.

translations.lxx: Joy rests long with the righteous: but the hope of the ungodly shall perish.
translations.kjv: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
translations.ron: Nădejdea celor drepţi este numai bucurie, iar nădejdea celor păcătoşi sfârşeşte în rău.
translations.grk: Ἐγχρονίζει δικαίοις εὐφροσύνη, ἐλπὶς δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀπολεῖται.

verses.geez: ፅንዑ፡ ለኄር፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወቀቅጥቃጤ፡ ለእለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ እኩየ።
verses.translation: The fear of the Lord is a strong hold of the saints: but ruin comes to them that work wickedness.

translations.lxx: The fear of the Lord is a strong hold of the saints: but ruin comes to them that work wickedness.
translations.kjv: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
translations.ron: Calea Domnului este o întăritură pentru cel desăvârşit şi o prăbuşire pentru cei ce săvârşesc fărădelegi.
translations.grk: Ὀχύρωμα ὁσίου φόβος Κυρίου, συντριβὴ δὲ τοῖς ἐργαζομένοις κακά.

verses.geez: ጻድቅ፡ ለዓለም፡ ኢይኤብስ፡ ወረሲዓንሰ፡ ኢየኀድሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: The righteous shall never fail: but the ungodly shall not dwell in the earth.

translations.lxx: The righteous shall never fail: but the ungodly shall not dwell in the earth.
translations.kjv: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
translations.ron: Niciodată cel drept nu se va clătina, iar cei nelegiuiţi nu vor locui pământul.
translations.grk: Δίκαιος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὐκ ἐνδώσει, ἀσεβεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἰκήσουσι γῆν.

verses.geez: አፈ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ይነብብ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወልሳነ፡ ዓማፅያን፡ ይትኀጐል።
verses.translation: The mouth of the righteous drops wisdom: but the tongue of the unjust shall perish.

translations.lxx: The mouth of the righteous drops wisdom: but the tongue of the unjust shall perish.
translations.kjv: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
translations.ron: Gura celui drept rodeşte înţelepciune, iar limba urzitoare de rele aduce pierzare.
translations.grk: Στόμα δικαίου ἀποστάζει σοφίαν, γλῶσσα δὲ ἀδίκου ἐξολεῖται.

verses.geez: ከናፍረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ያውኅዛ፡ ሞገሰ፡ ወአፈ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ይትከላእ፡ እምአእምሮ።
verses.translation: The lips of just men drop grace: but the mouth of the ungodly is perverse.

translations.lxx: The lips of just men drop grace: but the mouth of the ungodly is perverse.
translations.kjv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
translations.ron: Buzele celui drept cunosc bunăvoirea, iar gura păcătoşilor strâmbătatea.
translations.grk: Χείλη ἀνδρῶν δικαίων ἀποστάζει χάριτας, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀποστρέφεται.
